findings.article_section: Scope and source-access boundary; Produce a reviewable issue packet
findings.explanation: Fresh AS 2201 text and amendment applicability remain unverified. Revised text removes a presently verified substantive standard claim and leaves criteria for authorized primary-source/professional analysis.

findings.article_section: Describe what is known without filling the gaps
findings.explanation: The scenario explicitly stipulates missed reviews; missing signatures are not automatically called failures. Proposed evidence requests and observed assertions are kept separate.

findings.article_section: Why the detected amount is only one data point
findings.explanation: Ten August records produce 16.67% of 60 and 10% of 100; no July records are included. No confidence, severity or extrapolated maximum-loss claim is made.
Performance date, record availability and covered period remain distinct. Later evidence is not categorically rejected for earlier-date assessment.
No severity category, sampling minimum, operating period or remediation result is assigned. Standard applicability remains expressly open.
